summary: Frontend E2E test of Jumeaux registry + dedicated Revue page after modal removal. All 9 requested scenarios verified successfully. No role=dialog anywhere in the flow. Inline expansion, dedicated /jumeaux/:jid/revue page, admission workflow, demo reset, filters/chips/groupement/vues, menu ⋯, contexte Aurora checkbox, and 'Commander un jumeau' all work. No console errors on /, /atlas, /jumeaux, /jumeaux/logistique/revue.
critical_code_review_comments: Jumeaux.jsx is ~335 lines - manageable but combines many concerns (recherche, filtres, groupement, menu, expansion). Could benefit from extracting RegistreLigne and RegistreOutils components in future.
In Jumeaux.jsx line 88, the conditional filter for 'attention' uses an inline ternary that is hard to read: consider splitting into two explicit checks for maintainability.

Reset useEffect on version change clears revues and deplieId — good; but no toast/feedback when 'Copier l'identifiant' fails (navigator.clipboard may be undefined in some contexts). Wrap in try/catch.
seed_data_creation: None. Used POST /api/demo/reinitialiser after admission test to restore Logistique to Observation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Modales entièrement supprimées de Jumeaux : validation faite. jumeaux-row-{id} déplie inline via expansion-{id}; revue-complete-{id} navigue vers /jumeaux/{id}/revue. Pour observation → revoir-admission-{id} navigue directement vers page dédiée. confirmer-admission-btn admet et redirige vers /jumeaux (statut Actif). Reset demo via page.request.post (car urllib direct renvoie 403 — utiliser le contexte navigateur avec X-Persona).
